# Details

## Script information

In this notebook, we continue after the data processing (`01_processing_all.qmd`) and cover the downstream analysis that follows for the data group that includes the full **donor 32** subset of the data. This includes:

-   Perform analyses focused on CAR-T cells over all time points (t0-t3)
-   Address questions related to: a) How do T cells change over time (both CAR+ and CAR-) following CAR-T infusion?


\

## Study and experimental outline

Study led by Prof. Suzuki Yutaka and Dr. Kashima Yukie (Tokyo University, Japan). Samples collected from three donors (32, 44, 50) that have received CAR-T treatment. The CAR-T product was analyzed before infusion, and thereafter, PBMC samples were collected days post infusion (DPI) (8-9, 13, and 24 days).

Here, we will focus on the donor 32 time course samples (CAR-T product, 8 dpi, 13 dpi, and 24 dpi samples).

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warnings=FALSE, results='asis'}
sample_table <- "
|  Sample ID    |  Donor ID   | Sample type  | DPI  |
|:-------------:|:-----------:|:------------:|:----:|
| TKB_CAR_T_64  | 32          | CAR-T prod.  |  --  |
| TKB_CAR_T_73  | 32          | PBMC         |  d8  |
| TKB_CAR_T_79  | 32          | PBMC         |  d13 |
| TKB_CAR_T_84  | 32          | PBMC         |  d24 |
"
cat(sample_table)
```

# Analysis

For this analysis we are focusing on the donor 32 samples, that have samples covering four different time points (pre- and post-infusion). Thus, we will here look at the CAR-T cells and regular T cells to see how they behave over time, following CAR-T treatment in the patients.


For this downstream analysis we will aim to cover:

- Looking at T cell differences across time points (CAR+ when possible, otherwise the ordinary PBMC CD4/CD8 T cell populations)


## Overview

```{r}
cellcluster_freq_tbl <- data_d32@meta.data |>
  filter(!celltype == c("discard", "other")) |>
  filter(!celltype == "Platelets") |>
  group_by(sample, celltype) |>
  summarize(n_cells = n()) |>
  mutate(fraction = n_cells / sum(n_cells)) |>
  mutate(pct = round(fraction, 3) * 100) |>
  merge(mdat_df, by = "sample") |>
  mutate(celltype = as.factor(celltype))

cellcluster_freq_tbl |> display_dt(rownames = FALSE)
```

## Abundance

### Differential abundance

Perform differential abundance tests between t2 or t3 and t1. As we have too few of the FMC63+ cells for the later time points, we will instead focus on the regular T cell populations.

```{r}
groups_test <- grep("^CD", data_d32$celltype |> unique(), value = T) # c("CD4 T", "CD8 T")
groups_test <- grep("T$", groups_test, value = T)

tp_test <- paste0("t", 1:3)

#' Prepare data
dat_test <- data_d32 |>
  subset(celltype %in% groups_test & timepoint %in% tp_test)

#' Collect info about number of cells per group
daa_cell_stats <- dat_test[[]] |>
  rename(celltype = "celltype") |>
  group_by(celltype, donor, timepoint) |>
  summarize(n_cells = n())

daa_cell_stats |> knitr::kable()
```


```{r}
#' Run differential abundance test
daa_res <- RunDAA(
  dat_test,
  contrast_column = "timepoint",
  reference = "t1",
  targets = c("t2", "t3"),
  group_vars = "celltype"
)

daa_res <- daa_res |>
  rename(celltype = "celltype") |>
  relocate(celltype) |>
  relocate(difference, .before = p) |>
  mutate(sign = ifelse(p_adj < 0.01, "sign.", "n.s"))
```

```{r}
#' View results
display_dt(daa_res, rownames = FALSE)
```


```{r}
daa_res_sign <- daa_res |>
  mutate(contrast = paste0(target, "_vs_", reference)) |>
  mutate(cell_contrast = paste0(celltype, "_", contrast)) |>
  arrange(cell_contrast) |>
  filter(p_adj < 0.01)
```

```{r}
#' View significant results
display_dt(daa_res_sign |> relocate(cell_contrast), rownames = FALSE)
```

```{r}
dap_list <- daa_res_sign |>
  group_by(cell_contrast) |>
  group_map(~ .x$marker)

names(dap_list) <- daa_res_sign$cell_contrast |> unique()

dap_list
```

These results are based on all available proteins, without any pre-filtering on ensuring high and robust abundance across the tested populations. When looking at and visualizing the results themselves, we can add some additional filtering to only look at proteins that show an average abundance value of CLR > 0 for at least one of the groups in the comparison.  


### Visualizations

**Volcano plot**

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
p <- ggplot(daa_res, aes(x = difference, y = -log10(p_adj), color = sign)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), col = "grey") +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey80", "black")) +
  facet_wrap(target ~ celltype, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(1.1 * min(daa_res$difference), 1.1 * max(daa_res$difference))
  ) +
  theme_linedraw() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(abs(difference) > 0.5, as.character(marker), '')),
    hjust = -0.2,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
p

pdf(
  here("results", "analysis_d32", "abundance_daa_volcano_tcells.pdf"),
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)
p
dev.off()
```

## Spatial: Colocalization

### Prepare data

Start by fetching the colocalization score data and filter it to exclude low abundance markers.

```{r}
#' Fetch data
data_d32_prox <- data_d32
data_d32_prox$component <- NULL

colocscores_dat <- ColocalizationScores(
  data_d32_prox,
  meta_data_columns = c(
    "sample",
    "donor",
    "FMC63_status_clr",
    "celltype_broad",
    "celltype",
    "timepoint"
  )
)

colocscores_dat$celltype_timepoint <- paste0(
  colocscores_dat$celltype_broad,
  "_",
  colocscores_dat$timepoint
)
```

```{r}
#' Fetch marker count data
cts <- data_d32_prox %>%
  JoinLayers() %>%
  LayerData(layer = "counts") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("marker") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-marker, names_to = "component", values_to = "counts")

# Add counts info to the colocalization scores
colocscores_dat_filt <- colocscores_dat %>%
  left_join(cts, by = c("marker_1" = "marker", "component")) %>%
  rename(marker_1_count = counts) %>%
  left_join(cts, by = c("marker_2" = "marker", "component")) %>%
  rename(marker_2_count = counts) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(lower_marker_count = min(marker_1_count, marker_2_count))
```

```{r}
#' Filter to only retain marker pairs where the lowest abundant marker has an abundance
#' higher than 20 or the maximum isotype control abundance (whichever is higher)
count_cutoff <- 50
colocscores_dat_filt <- colocscores_dat_filt %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  filter(lower_marker_count > count_cutoff)
```

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
#' View the filtered colocalization score data
colocscores_dat_filt %>%
  group_by(marker_1, marker_2) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median = median(pearson_z)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = median)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(50, 100), linetype = "dashed", color = "orange") +
  xlab("count_of_expressing_cells") +
  ylab("pearson_z_median") +
  ggtitle("Colocalization Scores") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#' Filter data to exclude markers with very low component detection rate in samples.
#' We can set this to 50, which will exclude the marker pairs with the dominating variability in colocalization scores
n_cell_cutoff <- 50
colocscores_dat_filt <- colocscores_dat_filt %>%
  group_by(marker_1, marker_2, sample) %>%
  filter(n() >= n_cell_cutoff)
```

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
#' View the filtered colocalization score data
colocscores_dat_filt %>%
  group_by(marker_1, marker_2) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median = median(pearson_z)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = median)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(50), linetype = "dashed", color = "orange") +
  xlab("count_of_expressing_cells") +
  ylab("pearson_z_median") +
  ggtitle("Colocalization Scores - Filtered data") +
  theme_bw()
```

\

### Visualize raw scores

Look at the overall colocalization patterns we have in the samples and cell types of interest.

```{r}
#' Prepare colocalization score data for running `SummarizeProximityScores()`
colocscores_dat_filt_test <- colocscores_dat_filt
colocscores_dat_filt_test$join_count_z <- colocscores_dat_filt_test$pearson_z
```

To begin, we summarize the colocalization scores for every sample and cell type, which will allow us to study the colocalization patterns across donors and timepoints.

```{r}
colocscores_summarized <- SummarizeProximityScores(
  colocscores_dat_filt_test,
  group_vars = c("sample", "celltype"),
  proximity_metric = "join_count_z",
  summary_stat = "mean",
  include_missing_obs = T
)

colocscores_summarized <- colocscores_summarized |>
  rename(celltype = celltype) |>
  merge(mdat_df, by = "sample") |>
  as_tibble()
```

```{r fig.width=20, fig.height=20}
#| code-fold: true
#' Generate raw summarized colocalization score heatmaps for all samples and cell types
samples_plot <- colocscores_summarized$sample |> unique()
celltypes_plot <- colocscores_summarized$celltype |> unique()
celltypes_plot <- grep("CD", celltypes_plot, value = T) |> sort()

p_list_cells <- lapply(celltypes_plot, function(ct) {
  p_samples <- lapply(samples_plot, function(sample_select) {
    donor <- mdat_df |> filter(sample == sample_select) |> pull(donor)
    tp <- mdat_df |> filter(sample == sample_select) |> pull(timepoint)
    hm_title <- paste0(ct, " (", donor, ", ", tp, ")")
    p <- ColocalizationHeatmap(
      colocscores_summarized |> filter(celltype == ct, sample == sample_select),
      value_col = "mean_join_count_z",
      # size_col = "pct_detected",
      type = "tile",
      legend_title = "Mean\npearson Z",
      legend_range = c(-10, 10),
      treeheight_row = 20,
      treeheight_col = 20,
      main = hm_title
    )
    return(p |> ggplotify::as.ggplot())
  })
  p_grid <- wrap_plots(p_samples, ncol = 2)
  return(p_grid)
})
names(p_list_cells) <- celltypes_plot

# for(p in p_list_cells){print(p)}

pdf(
  here(
    "results",
    "analysis_d32",
    "colocalization_raw_summarized_scores_per_sample_tcell_equal.pdf"
  ),
  width = 20,
  height = 20
)
for (p in p_list_cells) {
  print(p)
}
dev.off()
```

```{r fig.width=20, fig.height=20}
#| results: asis
#| message: false
tabset_df <- tibble(
  name = names(p_list_cells),
  fig = p_list_cells
)

tabset_df |>
  quartabs::render_tabset(name, fig)
```

Let's do the same visualizations, but put to the same color scale and in the same marker order, for easier comparison.

```{r fig.width=17, fig.height=13}
#| code-fold: true
#' Generate raw summarized colocalization score heatmaps for all samples and cell types
samples_plot <- colocscores_summarized$sample |> unique()
celltypes_plot <- colocscores_summarized$celltype |> unique()
celltypes_plot <- grep("CD", celltypes_plot, value = T) |> sort()

p_list_cells <- lapply(celltypes_plot, function(ct) {
  markers_shared <- colocscores_summarized |>
    filter(celltype == ct) |>
    mutate(marker_pair = paste0(marker_1, ":", marker_2)) |>
    group_by(sample) |>
    select(sample, marker_pair) |>
    group_map(~ .x$marker_pair) |>
    setNames(nm = samples_plot)
  markers_shared <- Reduce(intersect, markers_shared) |>
    strsplit(":") |>
    unlist() |>
    unique()
  markers_shared <- c(markers_shared, "FMC63")

  p_samples <- list()
  for (i in c(2, 1, 3:4)) {
    # 1:length(samples_plot) # Set order based on t1, not t0
    sample_select <- samples_plot[i]
    donor <- mdat_df |> filter(sample == sample_select) |> pull(donor)
    tp <- mdat_df |> filter(sample == sample_select) |> pull(timepoint)
    hm_title <- paste0("\n", ct, " (", donor, ", ", tp, ")")

    if (i %in% c(2)) {
      p <- ColocalizationHeatmap_custom(
        colocscores_summarized |>
          filter(marker_1 %in% markers_shared, marker_2 %in% markers_shared) |>
          filter(celltype == ct, sample == sample_select) |>
          mutate(size_same = ifelse(abs(mean_join_count_z) < 0.01, 0, 1)) |>
          mutate(
            size_diff_mean = ifelse(
              abs(mean_join_count_z) < 0.01,
              0,
              abs(mean_join_count_z)
            ),
            size_constant = 1
          ),
        value_col = "mean_join_count_z",
        size_col = "size_constant",
        type = "dots",
        legend_range = c(-5, 5),
        size_range = c(1, 5),
        legend_title = "Mean\npearson Z"
      ) &
        labs(title = hm_title, x = "", y = "")

      p_build <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(p)
      m_order <- p_build$layout$panel_params[[1]]$x$get_labels()
    } else {
      p <- ColocalizationHeatmap_custom(
        colocscores_summarized |>
          filter(celltype == ct, sample == sample_select) |>
          filter(marker_1 %in% m_order, marker_2 %in% m_order) |>
          mutate(size_same = ifelse(abs(mean_join_count_z) < 0.01, 0, 1)) |>
          mutate(
            size_diff_mean = ifelse(
              abs(mean_join_count_z) < 0.01,
              0,
              abs(mean_join_count_z)
            ),
            size_constant = 1
          ),
        value_col = "mean_join_count_z",
        size_col = "size_constant",
        type = "dots",
        legend_range = c(-5, 5),
        size_range = c(2, 5),
        marker_order = m_order,
        cluster_rows = F,
        cluster_cols = F,
        legend_title = "Mean\npearson Z"
      ) &
        labs(title = hm_title, x = "", y = "")
    }

    # return(p |> ggplotify::as.ggplot())
    p_samples[[i]] <- p
  }
  p_grid <- wrap_plots(p_samples, ncol = 2)
  return(
    p_grid &
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0)
      )
  )
})
names(p_list_cells) <- celltypes_plot

pdf(
  here(
    "results",
    "analysis_d32",
    "colocalization_raw_summarized_scores_per_sample_tcell_dots_equal.pdf"
  ),
  width = 17,
  height = 13
)
for (p in p_list_cells) {
  print(p)
}
dev.off()
```

## Selected visualizations

### Beeswarm plots

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
#| code-fold: true
#| message: false
pal_donor_time <- setNames(
  c("#C0B2E9", "#A38EDC", "#876BCD", "#A1DAD0", "#3FAC9B", "#0D6D5E"),
  nm = mdat_df |> arrange(timepoint, donor) |> pull(sample)
)

celltypes_plot <- grep("CD", colocscores_dat$celltype |> unique(), value = T)

marker_pair_plot_list <- c(
  "FMC63:CD3E",
  "FMC63:CD45",
  "FMC63:CD8",
  "CD44:CD45",
  "CD43:CD44",
  "CD18:CD43",
  "CD18:CD55",
  "CD8:CD82",
  "CD45:CD82"
)

# marker_pair_plot <- marker_pair_plot_list[1]
p_list <- lapply(marker_pair_plot_list, function(marker_pair_plot) {
  message(marker_pair_plot)
  colocscores_plot <- colocscores_dat |>
    mutate(
      marker_pair = ifelse(
        marker_2 == "FMC63",
        paste0(marker_2, ":", marker_1),
        paste0(marker_1, ":", marker_2)
      )
    ) |>
    filter(celltype %in% celltypes_plot) |>
    filter(marker_pair %in% marker_pair_plot) |>
    # merge(mdat_df |> select(sample, donor), by = "sample") |>
    select(
      marker_pair,
      pearson_z,
      pearson_p_value_adjusted,
      timepoint,
      sample,
      donor,
      celltype,
      component
    )

  p1 <- ggplot(colocscores_plot, aes(x = timepoint, y = pearson_z)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_quasirandom(
      mapping = aes(color = timepoint, fill = timepoint),
      dodge.width = 0.8,
      size = .1,
      width = 0.12
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      aes(group = sample),
      fun = mean,
      fun.min = mean,
      fun.max = mean,
      geom = "crossbar",
      color = "black",
      width = 0.4,
      lwd = 0.25,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
    ) +
    facet_grid(~celltype) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_time) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pal_time) +
    labs(
      y = "Colocalization score\n(Pearson Z)",
      x = "",
      title = marker_pair_plot,
      caption = "bar: median value"
    ) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(
        color = "black",
        size = 10,
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      )
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))

  p <- p1

  return(p)
})
names(p_list) <- marker_pair_plot_list

pdf(
  here("results", "analysis_d32", "colocalization_raw_selected_beeswarm.pdf"),
  width = 8,
  height = 3
)
for (p in p_list) {
  print(p)
}
dev.off()
```
